embeds.title: 1. Follow Global & Channel Rules
embeds.description:
You have to follow both the global rules and channel-specific rules.

Ignorance of the rules is not an excuse; we expect you to have read them.

embeds.title: 2. No Support in Non-Support Channels
embeds.description:
You must not ask for support in any non-support channels.

Support channels include #support. Make sure to also read the FAQ before seeking support.

embeds.title: 3. English or Hindi Only
embeds.description:
You must use the English or Hindi language.

Some exceptions may be granted to non-conversational use and specific support cases.

embeds.title: 4. No sharing of 3rd-party repository links or APKs
embeds.description: Third-party repositories and apps are not affiliated with us in any way, are not supported here, and their security cannot be guaranteed. This also applies to DMing Staff.

embeds.title: 5. Follow Discord Community Guidelines
embeds.description:
Follow the [community guidelines](https://discord.com/guidelines) set by Discord.

We didn't make these rules but we will enforce them. We don't make exceptions for anyone.

embeds.title: 6. Mark Spoilers with Context
embeds.description:
Spoilable content needs to be marked with context.

Not everyone's definition is the same — you can read ours by using the `!spoilers` tag.

embeds.title: 7. No Unprompted Advertising
embeds.description:
Do not advertise unprompted.

This includes posting server invites, advertisements, etc. without a staff member's permission. This also includes DMing fellow members.

embeds.title: 8. No Impersonation
embeds.description: Do not pretend to be someone else, especially members with roles.

embeds.title: 9. Use Common Sense
embeds.description:
Use common sense, and don't behave poorly.

This includes but is not limited to: spamming, user mistreatment, DM/pinging unnecessarily, not listening to staff, disguising links, using pejoratives, and more.

embeds.title: 10. No Politics
embeds.description:
No politics.

"There is a time and place for everything, but not here." — Professor Oak.
